title: Vampire Vape Base Mix 70VG/30PG 500ml
description: This VG/PG base mix has a 70/30 ratio so you can easily make your own super flavourful sub ohm e-liquids at home using this base mix, e-liquid concentrates, and nicotine shots. This base mix makes e-liquid that's best suited to more powerful vape kits that can handle thicker liquids. This 500ml bottle comes pre-mixed and all you need to do is simply add whatever e-liquid flavour concentrates you want, and some nicotine shots if desired. Details: Vampire Vape Base Mix 70VG/30PG 500ml Just add flavour concentrates and nicotine shot (if required) Made in the UK
